import React from 'react'; import { FaHeart, FaUsers, FaChurch, FaGuitar } from 'react-icons/fa'; import { FiMusic, FiMic, FiCompass } from 'react-icons/fi'; const About = () => { return (
About

Meet Shawn Saldana

Dedicated to music, devoted to worship

A Heart for Music & Worship

Shawn is a passionate worship leader serving under the grace and guidance of Pastor Sijo Mathew and Pastor Ashwini Sijo Mathew. His journey in music is rooted in a desire to glorify God through every note, every rhythm, and every melody.

As the founder of Shawn's Academy of Music, he has dedicated his life to nurturing the next generation of musicians with excellence, humility, and grace.

Worship Leader

Leading worship with authenticity and spiritual depth, creating an atmosphere where heaven and earth meet.

Music Producer

Crafting original compositions and producing sessions for artists who want to bring their musical visions to life.

Mentor & Teacher

Training students one-on-one with patience and personalized attention to help each one discover their unique musical voice.

Faith-Filled

Every lesson, every session, and every production is anchored in faith and a commitment to excellence.

" Music is the language of the soul. Let's create something beautiful together. "

- Shawn Saldana
); }; export default About;
